name: rust-toolchain
label: Rust
description: cargo, as a build check, a test check, a lint check and a command. Nothing runs until you point each tool at a binary in Settings -> Tool Plugins.

tools.label: cargo build
tools.description: Compiles the crate and reports rustc diagnostics, read from cargo's JSON message stream.

tools.label: cargo test
tools.description: Runs the crate's tests and reports the failures from the stable toolchain's text output (the JSON runner is nightly-only).

tools.label: cargo clippy
tools.description: Runs clippy over every target and reports its lints through the same JSON message stream cargo build uses.

tools.label: cargo
tools.description: The cargo CLI itself, so a model can run a one-off subcommand through run_command.
